build_generator: build a HiFi-GAN Generator model from config to synthesize audio waveforms from latent features
build_code_generator: build a CodeGenerator that converts discrete codes with optional F0 and speaker embeddings into audio
build_discriminator: build a MultiPeriodDiscriminator or MultiScaleDiscriminator to evaluate real vs generated audio waveforms
build_quantizer: build a Quantizer with encoder, VQ bottleneck, and decoder to quantize F0 pitch features
run_discriminator_loss: run the discriminator_loss function to compute adversarial loss from real and generated discriminator outputs
